description: Enterprise GenAI conversational assistant (Copilot Chat) available to everyone with a University IT account, backed by Commercial Data Protection.
howToObtain: Log in to copilot.microsoft.com or Microsoft Teams using University credentials.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Copilot Chat is an AI-powered assistant available to everyone with a University account and accessible via a web browser or within Microsoft Teams.

Sometimes Copilot Chat may search the web using Microsoft’s search engine Bing in order to find information that is relevant to your prompt. When this occurs, fragments of your prompt may be sent to Bing. There is no way to prevent this from happening, however your identity is not shared, and the query is sent over a secure connection.

description: Microsoft 365 Copilot suite in phased license rollout across 65,000 colleagues and students; exclusive service permitted for staff handling student-identifiable data in teaching and learning (DocID 79331 §2.3.1).
howToObtain: Licenses assigned in phased cohorts; check the Microsoft 365 Copilot SharePoint space.
costToUser: Provided under University enterprise agreement; phased allocation

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University has announced a strategic collaboration with Microsoft, making Manchester the world’s first university to deploy equitable Microsoft 365 Copilot access and training across its entire community.

The roll out of licenses will be phased and implementation planning is now underway. Visit the Microsoft 365 Copilot SharePoint space for guidance, FAQs, training and updates as the roll out continues.

2.3.1   Staff members who use AI in Teaching and Learning activities must adhere to the
        University's AI Guidelines. Only the University-provided Microsoft 365 Copilot service
        may be used for student-identifiable or confidential data.

description: AI toolbox built within UoM's cloud environment for creating custom AI agents and safe experimentation.
howToObtain: Submit early access request via the Nebula One Request Form.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
NebulaONE is an AI toolbox built within UoM’s cloud environment. It uses market-leading models to help you create custom AI agents, no coding required.
Whether you're in research, teaching, or professional services, NebulaONE enables safe experimentation while ensuring full compliance with the University’s AI Guidelines.
We have recently started onboarding early adopters to test the NebulaONE AI system. If you’re interested in gaining early access, please sign up using the Nebula One Request Form.
